intel.turnedOk: Agent turned into a double agent

opsHelp.infiltrate_spy: Plants an agent in the target country: gradually reveals its provinces, buildings and intentions.
opsHelp.recruit_source: Recruits a local source: regular intention reports, variable rating.
opsHelp.turn_agent: Turns an exposed enemy agent to feed false information to its service.
opsHelp.exfiltrate: Brings home a threatened agent before capture.
opsHelp.steal_research: Steals research work: speeds up or unlocks a node.
opsHelp.sabotage_factory: Damages an industrial building of the target.
opsHelp.fund_rebels: Funds a rebellion in a province: lowers stability.
opsHelp.listen_area: Radio intercepts over an area: reveals the units present.
opsHelp.intercept_army: Follows an army's transmissions: orders and movements.
opsHelp.jam_area: Jams communications and radars in an area.
opsHelp.cyber_production: Slows down the target's industrial production.
opsHelp.cyber_orders: Delays the execution of the target's orders.
opsHelp.disinformation: Disinformation campaign: lowers the target's stability.
opsHelp.leak_plans: Publishes stolen plans on the world news wire.
opsHelp.plant_fake_report: Gets a fake report to the opposing service.
opsHelp.deploy_decoys: Deploys decoys that fool enemy reconnaissance.
opsHelp.fake_radio_traffic: Simulates radio traffic to mask your movements.
opsHelp.counterintel_sweep: Hunts foreign agents on your territory.
opsHelp.recon_economic: Reveals in phases the economic facilities (production, resources, industry) of an entire country — capital and major cities first, then the rest — or of a single province.
opsHelp.recon_military: Reveals in phases the bases, air defenses, radars, silos and bunkers of an entire country — capital and major cities first, then the rest — or of a single province. Then visible on the map.
opsHelp.cryptanalysis: Gradually breaks a nation's encryption: at 25% its movement orders become readable, at 50% its intentions. Strong encryption (advanced services) slows progress.
opsHelp.intercept_comms: Intercepts a nation's communications: traffic volume, movement orders and war plans depending on decryption. A strong enemy counterintelligence can inject fake traffic.
opsHelp.geolocate_emitters: Locates a nation's radars, air defenses and command posts from their emissions. SIGINT satellites and aircraft in service increase the number of emitters found.
opsHelp.cultivate_source: Raises a reliable agent's access: ministry (budget, research), then general staff (war plans). The higher the access, the more exposed the agent.
opsHelp.vet_agents: Checks your agents in a country: unmasks double agents and spots those under surveillance. No risk.
opsHelp.designate_targets: Imagery analysis of an enemy province: forces identified and located, facilities mapped, strikes proposed unit by unit.
opsHelp.dismantle_network: Dismantles a nation's network on your soil: arrests agents already spotted and hunts the others.
opsHelp.deception_plan: Feeds fake war plans to enemy services. More credible if the enemy has agents in your country, especially a turned agent.
opsHelp.harden_sites: Strengthens protection of all your facilities for a few days: sabotage, rebel funding and industrial cyberattacks are hampered.

delete.busy: The game is running on another server: try again in a moment.

rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.subtitle: Season points earned in multiplayer games.

endgame.title: Game summary
endgame.noStats: Detailed summary not recorded: the game was closed offline. The border timeline remains available.

effect.title: Effectiveness
effect.note: Average per category, based on the game's damage, interceptions and strikes.

stacks.detachHint: Mixed stack: detached elements are taken proportionally from each system.

block.owner: Only your own stacks can merge.
block.moving: Stacks must be stopped to merge.
block.distance: Stacks too far apart to merge (bring them closer).
block.domain: Incompatible equipment: ground units, helicopters, aircraft and drones do not mix; missiles, air defenses, radars and ships only merge with their own type.

audio.title: Sound
audio.muteHelp: Nothing is downloaded while sound is muted. Settings are saved on this device.
audio.reducedHelp: No battle ambience, softer cues, slower transitions (enabled automatically if the system asks to reduce motion).
audio.credits: Sounds and music generated for Red Line with ElevenLabs.

language.label: Language
language.help: Interface, dispatches and place names. The page reloads.
language.machine: Machine-generated translations, reviewed for military terms.

command.unavailable: The command center is not available in this game.

selection.open: Open the army in the command center

armiesLink.title: Command center
armiesLink.text: — form armies, give them a mission and hire generals who command them for you.

command.full: Limit of {{max}} armies reached: disband one to create another.
command.emptyText: Form an army from your stacks, give it a mission and choose a general: they command it for you.

onboard.title: How it works
onboard.compose: Gather land, air or naval stacks into a named army.
onboard.mission: Give it a mission: target designated on the map, aggressiveness, rules of engagement, retreat threshold.
onboard.general: Choose the general who commands it: his skills guide his decisions, he is paid every day.

command.pickText: Its mission, general, composition and the general's log appear here.

declare_war.title: Authorization to go to war
declare_war.text: The general asks for authorization to cross the border: it means war with {{nation}}.

strategic_strike.title: Authorization for strategic strikes
strategic_strike.text: The general asks for authorization to strike the rear installations of {{nation}}.

reinforce.title: Reinforcement request
reinforce.text_one: Strength falling: the general requests {{count}} free stack nearby.
reinforce.text_other: Strength falling: the general requests {{count}} free stacks nearby.

detail.noMissionText: No mission: the army awaits your orders, its stacks remain under your direct command.
detail.noGeneralText: Without a general, the army stays passive: no mission is carried out.
detail.manualHelp: Stack under your direct order: the general takes it back when the order ends.
detail.manualRule: Direct order on a stack: it prevails until it ends, then the general takes the stack back.
detail.journalEmpty: The general has not reported anything yet.

actions.dissolveText: Disband {{name}}? The stacks stay where they are, under your direct command; the general goes into reserve (still paid).

reinforce.label: Automatic reinforcements
reinforce.offHelp: The general never asks for reinforcements.
reinforce.askHelp: The general asks for reinforcements when strength falls; you approve.
reinforce.autoHelp: The general integrates nearby free stacks himself when strength falls.

aggr.label: Aggressiveness
aggr.cautiousHelp: Attacks only with clear superiority, retreats early, keeps fighters in reserve.
aggr.balancedHelp: Reasonable force ratio, retreat at half losses.
aggr.boldHelp: Attacks sooner and more objectives at once, retreats late, all fighters airborne.

strict.help: Strict: no war or strategic strike without your authorization; pursuit limited to the zone.

standard.help: Standard: the general asks your authorization before opening a war or striking the enemy rear.

free.help: Free: the general decides alone, including war against his mission's target.

target.own: This province is already yours: designate a foreign province.
target.needed: Designate the mission's target on the map.

pick.target: Tap the map to designate the mission's target.
pick.units: Select the stacks on the map, then confirm.

conquer.name: Conquer
conquer.desc: Take a province, a region or a whole country.

defend.name: Defend
defend.desc: Hold the cities of a zone and repel enemies entering it.

hold_front.name: Hold the front line
hold_front.desc: Spread forces along the border and counter-attack breakthroughs.

air_superiority.name: Air superiority
air_superiority.desc: Fighter patrols, airborne radar and suppression of defenses over a zone.

air_defense.name: Air defense
air_defense.desc: Cover the cities of a zone: surface-to-air defenses spread out, fighters on alert.

deep_strike.name: Deep strikes
deep_strike.desc: Destroy a country's revealed strategic installations.

sea_control.name: Sea control and blockade
sea_control.desc: Hold a maritime zone, sink enemy ships, blockade ports.

landing.name: Amphibious landing
landing.desc: Gather at the port, embark, cross under escort and take a coast or an island.

reserve.name: Reserve
reserve.desc: Stay back and counter-attack breakthroughs within a radius.

offense.label: Offense
offense.help: Choice and number of objectives, size of assault groups, damage when attacking.

defense.label: Defense
defense.help: Garrisons, counter-attacks, protection of stationary stacks.

logistics.label: Logistics
logistics.help: Rallying and staggered departures, route planning, endurance and supply.

air.label: Air
air.help: Air sorties, escorts, suppression of enemy air defenses.

audacity.label: Boldness
audacity.help: A bold general attacks with a lower force ratio; a cautious one waits for superiority.

experience.label: Experience
experience.help: Less friction (delayed orders), stronger bonuses; it grows with victories.

encircler.label: Master of encirclement
encircler.help: Prefers provinces already surrounded by his forces; one more objective per decision cycle.

thrifty.label: Careful with lives
thrifty.help: Demands clearer superiority and retreats earlier.

reckless.label: Reckless
reckless.help: Attacks with fewer forces, retreats late; more friction.

logistician.label: Outstanding logistician
logistician.help: Always rallies before the assault; better endurance and supply.

airman.label: Air ace
airman.help: One more air sortie and escort per decision cycle.

methodical.label: Methodical
methodical.help: Half the friction; a little more demanding before attacking.

blitz.label: Blitzkrieg
blitz.help: One more objective per decision cycle; attacks a little sooner.

general.dismissText: Dismiss {{name}}? A severance of {{value}} is paid; his army becomes passive.

generals.poolHint: Available officers: signing bonus of 5 days' pay on hiring.
generals.chiefHelp: The commander-in-chief raises the skills of the generals of his branch; his pay is higher.

land.name: Army
land.desc: Infantry, armour, artillery and surface-to-surface missiles: takes and holds ground.

air.name: Air Force
air.desc: Fighters, bombers, drones, AEW aircraft: opens the sky, strikes deep, supports the troops.

sea.name: Navy
sea.desc: Surface ships, submarines, transports: blockade, landing escort, strikes from the sea.

ad.name: Air Defence
ad.desc: SAM batteries and radars: protect the territory, the bases and the advancing troops.

ops.full: Maximum of {{max}} operations reached: close one.
ops.emptyText: Pick one or more countries, an objective and the generals who will lead it: they act for you.

onboard.title: An operation in three choices
onboard.targets: The target countries: on the map or by search, one or several.
onboard.goal: The objective: weaken forces, total air control, total conquest, strategic strikes, blockade…
onboard.staff: The generals, by command: each gets a role and forces, and they coordinate.
onboard.rule: Generals strike, advance, patrol and blockade on their own; a direct order on a stack takes priority until it ends.

attrition.name: Weaken forces
attrition.desc: Strike everything found: defences, aircraft, ground forces, ships, bases.

air_control.name: Total air control
air_control.desc: Destroy the air defence and the air force, then hold the sky with patrols.

conquest.name: Total conquest
conquest.desc: Take every province, capital included, sector by sector, with air support.

decapitation.name: Decapitation
decapitation.desc: Drive on the capital and take it as fast as possible.

strategic.name: Strategic strikes
strategic.desc: Industry, energy, bases: destroy the facilities revealed by intelligence.

sead.name: Neutralise air defence
sead.desc: Destroy known SAM batteries, radars and air defence sites.

blockade.name: Naval blockade
blockade.desc: Blockade the ports, sink the ships, cut the sea lanes.

defend_border.name: Hold the border
defend_border.desc: Defend the border against the designated country or countries, counter-attack.

occupy.name: Occupy a region
occupy.desc: Take and hold the provinces designated on the map.

roe.strict: Strict: the staff asks your permission before any entry into war.
roe.standard: Standard: launching the operation authorises war against the target countries.
roe.free: Free: the generals decide alone, pursuits included.

ops.cancelText: {{name}}: the generals go into reserve (still paid), the armies formed for the operation are dissolved and their stacks return to your direct command.
ops.askWar: The staff asks for permission to go to war against {{nation}}.
ops.targetsLead: Choose the target country or countries: tap them on the map or search for them.

pick.nation: Tap a country on the map to target it.
pick.province: Tap the provinces to occupy (one at a time).

ops.pickGoal: Choose the objective of the operation.
ops.estWithSuggestion: Estimate with the proposed staff; you will choose the generals at the next step.
ops.name: Operation name

toast.edited: New objective sent to the staff.

wizard.name: Army name
wizard.namePlaceholder: 1st Army, Southern Air Group, Mediterranean Fleet…
wizard.noFree: No free stack: all your stacks are already in an army.
wizard.generalLead: Choose the general who will command: for this mission, the key skill is “{{skill}}”.

council.open_one: Security Council session open: {{count}} resolution put to the vote.
council.open_other: Security Council session open: {{count}} resolutions put to the vote.
council.closed: Session closed: {{passed}} resolution(s) adopted out of {{count}}.

nuclear.headline: Nuclear detonation: {{place}}
nuclear.body: A nuclear weapon fired by {{nation}} has exploded: {{place}}.

allianceInvite.title: Alliance invitation
allianceInvite.text: The {{alliance}} alliance invites you to join.

strikeAborted.title: Strike cancelled
strikeAborted.gone: {{system}}: target gone (destroyed or out of reach). Returning to base.
strikeAborted.moved: {{system}}: target out of reach (it has moved). Returning to base.
strikeAborted.lost: {{system}}: target lost from sight. Returning to base.

radarsBlinded.title: Radars blinded
radarsBlinded.text: A cyberattack is disrupting our radars.

nuclearRevoked.title: Nuclear authorization lifted
nuclearRevoked.text: Nuclear forces return to normal control.

nuclearAuthorized.title: Nuclear use authorized
nuclearAuthorized.text: Nuclear strikes are possible as long as the alert level allows it.

fuelLost.title: Aircraft lost
fuelLost.text: {{system}}: fuel exhausted before returning to base.

generalReleased.title: Direct control resumed
generalReleased.text: {{general}} hands back direct command of the group.

agentCaught.title: Agent exposed
agentCaught.text: {{host}} announces the arrest of an agent of {{owner}}.

detaineeNew.title: Foreign agent detained
detaineeNew.text: An agent of {{owner}} is in our hands: decision expected within {{days}} days.

detaineeHeld.title: Pre-trial detention
detaineeHeld.text: With no decision, the agent of {{owner}} is placed in pre-trial detention.

spyInterrogated.title: Agent interrogated
spyInterrogated.text: {{codename}} is being interrogated by the services of {{host}}.

spyReturned.title: Agent deported
spyReturned.text: {{codename}} has been sent back home by {{host}}.

spyJailed.title: Agent sentenced
spyJailed.text: {{codename}} sentenced to {{days}} days in prison by {{host}}.

spyServed.title: Sentence served
spyServed.text: {{codename}} has served the sentence ({{host}}) and is coming home.

swapAccepted.title: Exchange concluded
swapAccepted.text: Agreement on detained agents between {{a}} and {{b}}.

reprisalExecute.title: Reprisals
reprisalExecute.text: {{nation}} executes one of our detained agents in reprisal.

reprisalJail.title: Reprisals
reprisalJail.text: {{nation}} hardens the detention of our agents (maximum sentences).

reprisalArrest.title: Reprisals
reprisalArrest.text: {{nation}} arrests one of our agents in reprisal.

captureBlocked.title: Capture impossible
captureBlocked.noCapturer: {{system}} cannot capture {{place}}: infantry, armour or artillery is required.
captureBlocked.noWar: Not at war with the owner of {{place}}: no capture.

cmd_generalResigned.title: Resignation
cmd_generalResigned.text: {{general}} resigns: his pay is no longer being paid.

cmd_generalUnpaid.title: Unpaid salary
cmd_generalUnpaid.text: {{general}} has not been paid ({{days}}/{{max}} days before resignation).

cmd_generalKilled.title: General killed
cmd_generalKilled.text: {{general}} was killed in a strike on the HQ of {{army}}.

cmd_askWar.title: Authorization requested
cmd_askWar.text: {{army}}: {{general}} asks for authorization to go to war with {{nation}}.

cmd_askStrike.title: Authorization requested
cmd_askStrike.text: {{army}}: {{general}} asks for authorization to strike the rear of {{nation}}.

cmd_opAskWar.title: Permission requested
cmd_opAskWar.text: Operation {{op}}: the staff asks for permission to go to war against {{nation}}.

cmd_opAchieved.title: Objective achieved
cmd_opAchieved.text: Operation {{op}}: objective achieved and being held.

cmd_opHeavyLosses.title: Heavy losses
cmd_opHeavyLosses.text: Operation {{op}}: {{pct}} % of forces lost in 24 h.

j.missionCleared: Mission lifted: the stacks await your orders.
j.reinforceRefused: Reinforcements refused: {{general}} will make do with his forces.
j.declaredWar: Border crossed: we are at war with {{nation}}.
j.warBlocked: Unable to go to war with {{nation}}: mission suspended.
j.askWar: Authorization request: cross the border of {{nation}}.
j.askStrike: Authorization request: strike the rear of {{nation}}.
j.retreat: {{system}} too worn down: falling back on {{province}}.
j.noReinforcements: No free stack nearby to reinforce us.
j.tooWeak: Insufficient forces to attack ({{pct}}% of what is needed): reinforcements requested.
j.landing: Landing launched on {{province}}: assembling at the port.
j.noIntel: No installation of {{nation}} revealed: intelligence is needed (reconnaissance).
j.daily: Daily report: strength {{strength}}%, {{captures}} capture(s), {{losses}} element(s) lost.
j.wounded: {{general}} is wounded at the HQ: {{days}} days of convalescence.
j.opClosed: Operation {{op}} closed: the army awaits your orders.

op.warBlocked: Unable to go to war against {{nation}}: operation suspended.
op.askWar: Permission requested: go to war against {{nation}}.
op.jointAssault: Joint assault by the generals on {{province}}, led by {{army}}.
op.tooWeak: {{army}}: insufficient forces before {{province}} — air support and reinforcements requested.
op.sectorDone: {{army}}: sector taken, now supporting the rest of the theatre.
op.recon: No known target: reconnaissance launched over {{nation}}.
op.achieved: Objective achieved: it is being held.
op.heavyLosses: Heavy losses: {{pct}} % of committed forces lost in 24 h.
op.stuck: Operation bogged down: no progress for {{hours}} h.

spyNews.executedB: {{host}} announces the execution of an agent of {{owner}} convicted of espionage. International condemnation.
spyNews.swapB: {{a}} and {{b}} carried out a prisoner exchange: {{n}} agent(s) released.
